reason: £240 for refurbished alloys with no tyres is more than I'd pay when I can usually pick up a decent used set on Marketplace for £120-180 and haggle. The viewing and fit guarantee are good, but a new seller with no reviews isn't enough to get me to pay full price.
objection: Tyres aren't included, so the real cost is £240 plus four tyres, and I can't haggle on a set priced for new-seller buyers. Are the tyres any good?
would_change_my_mind: A set with decent tyres (4mm+ tread) included at £240, or the wheels alone at around £170-180.
